purpose: Photoreal visual target for original feline samurai modeling, fur, cloth and lighting; concept only, not runtime geometry or texture.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: photorealistic art-direction reference for a premium Unreal Engine first-person game character. Create a full-body three-quarter portrait of Nyaagyu, an original adult anthropomorphic Japanese domestic cat samurai in an alternate Edo era, standing upright with believable feline anatomy, digitigrade legs, paw hands capable of gripping a sheathed katana, realistic tabby fur with individual strands and natural facial structure (muzzle, whiskers, ears, eyes), not a human face with cat ears. Restrained dark indigo haori, worn hakama, layered lacquered lamellar armor, subtly weathered silk and timber details; one discreet cyan science-fiction energy module on the sword scabbard. His expression is serious and determined, a veteran protecting a village from alien bankers. Rain-damp stone courtyard and warm paper lanterns behind him, faint cold alien architecture far in the background. Cinematic naturalistic photography / physically based materials, nuanced skin and fur shading, realistic cloth weave, dramatic but readable rim lighting, 35mm full-body composition, no on-image text, no logo, no watermark. Avoid cartoon proportions, anime styling, plastic smoothness, oversized eyes, extra limbs, modern firearms, and violent gore.
limitations: Generated 2D concept; no rig, production mesh, fur groom, animation, UVs, gameplay collision, material calibration, or UE rendering validation. Environment insignia in the image is incidental artwork and is not the supplied SORA logo.
